series.title: The Foundations of Hindu Mythology
series.note: This series gives listeners the background they need before encountering the more complicated stories.

episodes.title: Before the Beginning: How Did the Universe Begin?
episodes.covers: Cosmic creation, the primordial waters, and the Nasadiya Sukta's mysterious questions about existence.
episodes.source: Rig Veda (Griffith translation) 10.129, the Nasadiya Sukta; Vishnu Purana (Wilson translation) book 1

script.title: How the Universe Began
script.description: Before the gods, before the sky, there was dark water and a question. The Nasadiya Sukta's famous doubt, Vishnu asleep on the serpent Shesha, and Brahma waking inside a lotus to build the world.

episodes.title: Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva: The Three Cosmic Powers
episodes.covers: The Trimurti, their traditional roles, and why different Hindu traditions understand them differently.
episodes.source: Vishnu Purana (Wilson translation) book 1; Shiva Purana

script.title: Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva
script.description: The creator, the preserver and the destroyer, and the day Brahma and Vishnu fought over who was greatest until a pillar of fire with no top and no bottom appeared between them.

episodes.title: The Many Gods of Hindu Mythology
episodes.covers: Devas, asuras, devas' kings, divine attendants, and the different roles of the gods.
episodes.source: Rig Veda (Griffith translation); Vishnu Purana (Wilson translation) book 1

script.title: The Many Gods of Hindu Mythology
script.description: Devas and asuras are half-brothers. Meet the whole family, from Indra and his thunderbolt to Agni, Yama and Kubera, and hear how Indra freed the world's waters from the serpent Vritra.

episodes.title: The Seven Worlds Above and Below
episodes.covers: Lokas, celestial realms, the underworlds, and the beings associated with them.
episodes.source: Vishnu Purana (Wilson translation) book 2

script.title: The Seven Worlds Above and Below
script.description: A journey through all fourteen worlds: oceans of milk and honey, golden Mount Meru, the Pole Star that was once a little prince, jewel-lit underworlds, and the serpent who holds it all up.

episodes.title: The Four Yugas: The Rise and Fall of the Ages
episodes.covers: Satya, Treta, Dvapara, and Kali Yuga, and the changing condition of dharma.
episodes.source: Vishnu Purana (Wilson translation) books 1 and 6; Mahabharata (Ganguli translation) Vana Parva, Markandeya's discourse

script.title: The Four Yugas
script.description: Bhima cannot lift an old monkey's tail. The monkey is Hanuman, and he explains the four great ages of the world, from the age of truth to the Kali Yuga we live in now, and the rider still to come.

episodes.title: What Happens When the Universe Ends?
episodes.covers: Pralaya, cosmic dissolution, and cycles of creation and renewal.
episodes.source: Vishnu Purana (Wilson translation) book 6

script.title: When the Universe Ends
script.description: Fire, flood and a sleeping god: how Hindu tradition tells the end of the universe, through the eyes of a sage who survived it, and found a child floating on the dark water.

episodes.title: Devas vs Asuras: Why Are the Gods Always at War?
episodes.covers: The relationship between devas and asuras, their rivalries, and why the conflict is more complicated than good versus evil.
episodes.source: Mahabharata (Ganguli translation) Adi Parva; Shatapatha Brahmana (Eggeling translation)

script.title: Devas and Asuras: The Endless War
script.description: The gods and the demons are brothers, born of one father. And when the demons learn the secret of bringing the dead back to life, the gods send one young man into their kingdom to steal it.

episodes.title: Karma and Rebirth: What Determines Your Next Life?
episodes.covers: Actions and consequences, samsara, and rebirth as explained through Hindu traditions.
episodes.source: Brihadaranyaka and Chandogya Upanishads (Muller translation); Bhagavad Gita

script.title: Karma and Rebirth: Your Next Life
script.description: A proud young scholar is asked five questions by a king, about where we go when we die, and he cannot answer a single one. His father has to go and learn the answer for himself.

episodes.title: The Saptarishis: The Seven Great Sages
episodes.covers: The rishis, their roles in transmitting knowledge, and their place in cosmic cycles.
episodes.source: Mahabharata (Ganguli translation); Vishnu Purana (Wilson translation) book 3

script.title: The Saptarishis: The Seven Great Sages
script.description: Seven sages wander a land dying of drought, starving, and still refusing a king's gold. Then someone steals the only food they have left, and each of them swears an oath.

episodes.title: The Sacred Books: Where Do These Stories Come From?
episodes.covers: An accessible introduction to the Vedas, Upanishads, epics, Puranas, and regional traditions.
episodes.source: Rig Veda (Griffith translation); Upanishads (Muller translation); Mahabharata (Ganguli translation)

script.title: The Sacred Books: Where the Stories Come From
script.description: Hymns that were memorised for three thousand years, a teacher who explained the universe with a bowl of salt water, and an epic dictated to Ganesha. A journey through the books behind Hindu mythology.

episodes.title: Who Is Shiva? The God Who Stands Outside the Rules
episodes.covers: Shiva's ascetic life, cosmic role, symbols, and seemingly contradictory nature.
episodes.source: Shiva Purana; Svetasvatara Upanishad

script.title: Who Is Shiva? The God Outside the Rules
script.description: He lives on a frozen mountain, covers himself in ash, wears a snake for a necklace and is also the gentlest of husbands. A story of Shiva walking into a forest of proud sages shows who he really is.

episodes.title: How Shiva Married Sati: The Love That Ended in Tragedy
episodes.covers: Sati, Daksha's sacrifice, Shiva's grief, and the destruction of Daksha's ritual.
episodes.source: Shiva Purana, Rudra Samhita, Sati Khanda; Bhagavata Purana book 4

script.title: How Shiva Married Sati, and How It Ended
script.description: A princess who loved the wild god of the mountains married him against her father's wishes. Then her father held a great sacrifice, and invited everyone except her husband.

episodes.title: Sati's Death and the Birth of Shakti Peethas
episodes.covers: The story of Sati's body and the sacred geography associated with Shakti Peethas, noting variations across traditions.
episodes.source: Devi Bhagavata Purana (Vijnanananda translation) book 7; Shiva Purana

episodes.title: How Parvati Won Shiva's Love
episodes.covers: Parvati's determination, austerities, and the return of Shiva to worldly life.
episodes.source: Kalidasa's Kumarasambhava (Griffith translation); Shiva Purana, Rudra Samhita, Parvati Khanda

episodes.title: Ganesha's Birth: Why Did Shiva Cut Off His Son's Head?
episodes.covers: Parvati's creation of Ganesha, their confrontation, and the elephant head.
episodes.source: Shiva Purana, Rudra Samhita, Kumara Khanda

episodes.title: Kartikeya and the Birth of the God of War
episodes.covers: The divine birth, the threat posed by Tarakasura, and Kartikeya's role as commander of the gods.
episodes.source: Valmiki Ramayana (Griffith translation) Bala Kanda; Kalidasa's Kumarasambhava (Griffith translation); Mahabharata (Ganguli translation) Vana Parva

episodes.title: The Churning of the Ocean: Shiva and the Deadly Poison
episodes.covers: The emergence of halahala poison and Shiva's act of cosmic protection.
episodes.source: Mahabharata (Ganguli translation) Adi Parva; Bhagavata Purana book 8

episodes.title: The Descent of the Ganga: How Shiva Saved the Earth
episodes.covers: Bhagiratha's quest, Ganga's descent, and Shiva's role in controlling her force.
episodes.source: Valmiki Ramayana (Griffith translation) Bala Kanda; Mahabharata (Ganguli translation) Vana Parva

episodes.title: Shiva Burns Kama: Why Did the God of Love Become Ashes?
episodes.covers: Kama's attempt to awaken Shiva's desire and the consequences of interrupting his meditation.
episodes.source: Kalidasa's Kumarasambhava (Griffith translation); Shiva Purana

episodes.title: Nataraja: The Dance That Creates and Destroys the Universe
episodes.covers: Shiva's cosmic dance, its symbolism, and the relationship between destruction and renewal.
episodes.source: Shiva Purana; the Chidambaram temple tradition

series.title: Vishnu and the Avatars
series.note: The Dashavatara tradition is a useful organising framework, but lists and interpretations vary between texts and communities. These episodes cover the major avatar stories without pretending that every tradition follows one identical list.

episodes.title: Why Does Vishnu Descend to Earth?
episodes.covers: The purpose of avatars, the restoration of dharma, and the idea of divine intervention.
episodes.source: Bhagavad Gita 4.7-8; Bhagavata Purana book 1

episodes.title: Matsya: The Fish Who Saved the World from the Flood
episodes.covers: The great flood, Manu, and the preservation of life and sacred knowledge.
episodes.source: Shatapatha Brahmana 1.8.1 (Eggeling translation); Bhagavata Purana book 8

episodes.title: Kurma: The Tortoise Beneath the Mountain
episodes.covers: Mount Mandara, the churning of the ocean, and Vishnu's support of the cosmic enterprise.
episodes.source: Bhagavata Purana book 8; Mahabharata (Ganguli translation) Adi Parva

episodes.title: Varaha: The Boar Who Rescued the Earth
episodes.covers: Hiranyaksha, the submerged Earth, and Vishnu's battle to restore it.
episodes.source: Vishnu Purana (Wilson translation) book 1; Bhagavata Purana book 3

episodes.title: Narasimha: The Man-Lion Who Defeated an Impossible Boon
episodes.covers: Hiranyakashipu, Prahlada, and the loophole that allowed the seemingly invincible demon to be defeated.
episodes.source: Vishnu Purana (Wilson translation) book 1; Bhagavata Purana book 7

episodes.title: Vamana: The Dwarf Who Claimed the Three Worlds
episodes.covers: King Bali, Vishnu's dwarf incarnation, and the three cosmic strides.
episodes.source: Bhagavata Purana book 8; Vishnu Purana (Wilson translation) book 3; Rig Veda (Griffith translation) 1.22

episodes.title: Parashurama: The Warrior Sage Who Challenged the Kings
episodes.covers: The conflict between Brahmins and Kshatriyas in the traditional narrative and Parashurama's place among Vishnu's avatars.
episodes.source: Mahabharata (Ganguli translation) Vana and Shanti Parvas; Bhagavata Purana book 9

episodes.title: Rama: The Prince Who Became a God
episodes.covers: Rama's role as an avatar, his ideals, and the different ways traditions understand him.
episodes.source: Valmiki Ramayana (Griffith translation)

episodes.title: Krishna: The Avatar Who Changed the Course of History
episodes.covers: Krishna's divine identity, his role in the Mahabharata, and his relationship with Arjuna.
episodes.source: Mahabharata (Ganguli translation); Bhagavata Purana book 10

episodes.title: Kalki: The Warrior Yet to Come
episodes.covers: The future avatar, the end of Kali Yuga in traditional cosmology, and the renewal of cosmic order.
episodes.source: Vishnu Purana (Wilson translation) book 4; Mahabharata (Ganguli translation) Vana Parva

series.title: The Ramayana: The Journey of Rama
series.note: This is the first major continuous epic. Use the Valmiki Ramayana as the primary narrative backbone, while flagging significant differences in other tellings.

episodes.title: The Birth of Rama: The Princes of Ayodhya
episodes.covers: Dasharatha, his sons, and the origins of Rama's story.
episodes.source: Valmiki Ramayana (Griffith translation) Bala Kanda

episodes.title: Vishvamitra's Request: Rama's First Great Adventure
episodes.covers: The young princes, the forest journey, and their encounter with threats to the sages' rituals.
episodes.source: Valmiki Ramayana (Griffith translation) Bala Kanda

episodes.title: Sita's Swayamvara: The Bow That Only Rama Could Lift
episodes.covers: Sita's marriage, Shiva's bow, and the joining of two royal families.
episodes.source: Valmiki Ramayana (Griffith translation) Bala Kanda

episodes.title: The Exile of Rama: How a Promise Changed a Kingdom
episodes.covers: Kaikeyi's demands, Dasharatha's promise, and Rama's departure.
episodes.source: Valmiki Ramayana (Griffith translation) Ayodhya Kanda

episodes.title: Life in the Forest: Surpanakha and the Events That Changed Everything
episodes.covers: The forest years, encounters with its inhabitants, and the conflict that escalates toward Sita's abduction.
episodes.source: Valmiki Ramayana (Griffith translation) Aranya Kanda

episodes.title: The Golden Deer: How Ravana Abducted Sita
episodes.covers: Maricha's deception, Sita's abduction, and Jatayu's attempt to intervene.
episodes.source: Valmiki Ramayana (Griffith translation) Aranya Kanda

episodes.title: Rama Meets Hanuman: The Search for Sita Begins
episodes.covers: Rama and Lakshmana's search, Hanuman's first meeting with Rama, and the alliance with Sugriva.
episodes.source: Valmiki Ramayana (Griffith translation) Kishkindha Kanda

episodes.title: Vali and Sugriva: The Battle for the Vanara Kingdom
episodes.covers: The brothers' rivalry, Rama's intervention, and the moral questions surrounding Vali's death.
episodes.source: Valmiki Ramayana (Griffith translation) Kishkindha Kanda

episodes.title: Hanuman's Leap to Lanka
episodes.covers: The crossing of the ocean, the obstacles along the way, and Hanuman's arrival in Lanka.
episodes.source: Valmiki Ramayana (Griffith translation) Sundara Kanda

episodes.title: Hanuman in Lanka: Finding Sita in Ashoka Vatika
episodes.covers: Hanuman's meeting with Sita, the exchange of Rama's token, and his confrontation with Ravana's forces.
episodes.source: Valmiki Ramayana (Griffith translation) Sundara Kanda

episodes.title: The Bridge to Lanka and the Great War
episodes.covers: The ocean crossing, the siege, major battles, and the fall of Ravana.
episodes.source: Valmiki Ramayana (Griffith translation) Yuddha Kanda

episodes.title: Rama's Return to Ayodhya: Victory, Kingship, and What Came Next
episodes.covers: The return, the coronation, and an introduction to the later Uttara Kanda traditions and their difficult questions.
episodes.source: Valmiki Ramayana (Griffith translation) Yuddha Kanda and Uttara Kanda

series.title: The Mahabharata: The Fall of a Dynasty
series.note: The Mahabharata is much larger than a straightforward war story. Its family history, moral dilemmas, embedded tales, and philosophical teachings deserve a substantial series.

episodes.title: The Origins of the Kuru Dynasty
episodes.covers: Shantanu, Ganga, Bhishma, and the events that shape the royal succession.
episodes.source: Mahabharata (Ganguli translation) Adi Parva

episodes.title: The Birth of the Pandavas and the Kauravas
episodes.covers: Pandu, Dhritarashtra, Kunti, Madri, Gandhari, and the unusual births of their children.
episodes.source: Mahabharata (Ganguli translation) Adi Parva

episodes.title: Karna: The Abandoned Prince Who Became a Legend
episodes.covers: Kunti's secret, Karna's upbringing, his ambition, and his bond with Duryodhana.
episodes.source: Mahabharata (Ganguli translation) Adi, Vana and Udyoga Parvas

episodes.title: Drona's School: The Rivalry Between the Princes
episodes.covers: The education of the royal cousins, Arjuna's skill, Ekalavya, and the growing tensions.
episodes.source: Mahabharata (Ganguli translation) Adi Parva

episodes.title: The House of Lac: The Pandavas Escape a Deadly Trap
episodes.covers: Duryodhana's plot, the burning palace, and the brothers' escape.
episodes.source: Mahabharata (Ganguli translation) Adi Parva, Jatugriha

episodes.title: Draupadi's Swayamvara: How Five Brothers Married One Woman
episodes.covers: Draupadi's contest, Arjuna's victory, and the circumstances leading to the marriage of the five Pandavas.
episodes.source: Mahabharata (Ganguli translation) Adi Parva, Swayamvara

episodes.title: Indraprastha and the Rise of the Pandavas
episodes.covers: The division of the kingdom, the building of Indraprastha, and the Rajasuya sacrifice.
episodes.source: Mahabharata (Ganguli translation) Sabha Parva

episodes.title: The Dice Game: How the Pandavas Lost Everything
episodes.covers: Shakuni's dice, Yudhishthira's decisions, and the collapse of the Pandavas' fortunes.
episodes.source: Mahabharata (Ganguli translation) Sabha Parva

episodes.title: Draupadi in the Kuru Court: The Question Nobody Could Answer
episodes.covers: Draupadi's humiliation, her questions about the legality of the wager, and the court's moral failure.
episodes.source: Mahabharata (Ganguli translation) Sabha Parva

episodes.title: Thirteen Years in Exile: The Trials of the Pandavas
episodes.covers: Forest adventures, encounters with sages, and the final year in disguise.
episodes.source: Mahabharata (Ganguli translation) Vana and Virata Parvas

episodes.title: Krishna's Peace Mission: Can War Still Be Prevented?
episodes.covers: Negotiations, failed diplomacy, and the final march toward Kurukshetra.
episodes.source: Mahabharata (Ganguli translation) Udyoga Parva

episodes.title: The Bhagavad Gita: Why Krishna Taught Arjuna to Fight
episodes.covers: Arjuna's crisis, Krishna's teachings, duty, action, devotion, and liberation.
episodes.source: Mahabharata (Ganguli translation) Bhishma Parva; Bhagavad Gita

episodes.title: Bhishma's Fall: The First Great Turning Point of the War
episodes.covers: The early battles, Bhishma's leadership, and the strategy that brings him down.
episodes.source: Mahabharata (Ganguli translation) Bhishma Parva

episodes.title: Abhimanyu and the Chakravyuha
episodes.covers: The young warrior's entry into the battle formation and the events surrounding his death.
episodes.source: Mahabharata (Ganguli translation) Drona Parva

episodes.title: Karna, Drona, and the Final Days of War
episodes.covers: The deaths of major warriors, shifting loyalties, and the moral cost of victory.
episodes.source: Mahabharata (Ganguli translation) Drona, Karna and Shalya Parvas

episodes.title: The End of the Mahabharata: Ashwatthama, Krishna, and the Pandavas' Final Journey
episodes.covers: The aftermath, the collapse of the dynasty, the end of Krishna's earthly life, and the Pandavas' final ascent.
episodes.source: Mahabharata (Ganguli translation) Sauptika, Mausala, Mahaprasthanika and Svargarohana Parvas

episodes.title: Who Is Adi Shakti? The Power Behind the Universe
episodes.covers: Shakti as divine power, the goddess traditions, and the idea of the feminine as ultimate reality in some schools.
episodes.source: Devi Bhagavata Purana (Vijnanananda translation); Devi Mahatmya (Markandeya Purana, Pargiter translation)

episodes.title: Mahishasura: The Demon No God Could Defeat
episodes.covers: The boon, the gods' defeat, and the manifestation of Durga.
episodes.source: Devi Mahatmya (Markandeya Purana, Pargiter translation), the middle episode

episodes.title: The Battle of Durga and Mahishasura
episodes.covers: The goddess's battle, the demon's transformations, and the triumph of divine power.
episodes.source: Devi Mahatmya (Markandeya Purana, Pargiter translation), the middle episode

episodes.title: Kali: The Goddess Who Appeared on the Battlefield
episodes.covers: Kali's emergence, her terrifying forms, and her relationship with Durga in key narratives.
episodes.source: Devi Mahatmya (Markandeya Purana, Pargiter translation), the final episode

episodes.title: Kali and Shiva: The Meaning Behind the Image
episodes.covers: The traditions behind Kali standing upon Shiva and the symbolism of power, restraint, and cosmic balance.
episodes.source: Devi Mahatmya (Markandeya Purana, Pargiter translation); later Bengali Shakta tradition

episodes.title: Lakshmi: The Goddess Who Emerged from the Ocean
episodes.covers: Lakshmi's appearance during the churning of the ocean and her association with prosperity and fortune.
episodes.source: Vishnu Purana (Wilson translation) book 1; Bhagavata Purana book 8

episodes.title: Saraswati: The Goddess of Knowledge and the Arts
episodes.covers: Saraswati's symbolism, associations with learning, and place in devotional traditions.
episodes.source: Rig Veda (Griffith translation) hymns to Sarasvati; Devi Bhagavata Purana (Vijnanananda translation)

episodes.title: Parvati, Durga, and Kali: Are They Different Goddesses?
episodes.covers: How traditions understand distinct forms, manifestations, and identities of the goddess.
episodes.source: Devi Mahatmya (Markandeya Purana, Pargiter translation); Devi Bhagavata Purana (Vijnanananda translation)

episodes.title: The Story of Sati and the Sacred Shakti Peethas
episodes.covers: A deeper look at the legend, sacred sites, and the differences between lists and tellings.
episodes.source: Devi Bhagavata Purana (Vijnanananda translation) book 7; Shiva Purana

episodes.title: Navaratri: Nine Nights of the Goddess
episodes.covers: The major narratives behind the festival, its different regional forms, and its devotional significance.
episodes.source: Devi Mahatmya (Markandeya Purana, Pargiter translation); Devi Bhagavata Purana (Vijnanananda translation) book 3

series.title: Sages, Demons, Kings, and Cosmic Legends
series.note: These are essential stories from the wider mythological universe, especially the Puranas. They add context that the two great epics alone cannot provide.

episodes.title: Samudra Manthana: The Churning of the Cosmic Ocean
episodes.covers: The devas and asuras cooperate, the treasures emerge, and amrita becomes the prize.
episodes.source: Mahabharata (Ganguli translation) Adi Parva; Vishnu Purana (Wilson translation) book 1

episodes.title: Mohini: The Enchantress Who Outwitted the Asuras
episodes.covers: Vishnu's Mohini form and the distribution of the nectar of immortality.
episodes.source: Mahabharata (Ganguli translation) Adi Parva; Bhagavata Purana book 8

episodes.title: Prahlada: The Child Who Refused to Abandon Vishnu
episodes.covers: A devotee's faith in the face of persecution by his own father.
episodes.source: Vishnu Purana (Wilson translation) book 1; Bhagavata Purana book 7

episodes.title: Dhruva: The Boy Who Became the Pole Star
episodes.covers: Rejection, determination, penance, divine grace, and the origin of Dhruva's celestial place.
episodes.source: Vishnu Purana (Wilson translation) book 1

episodes.title: Markandeya: The Boy Who Defeated Death
episodes.covers: The young sage, his destined death, and his encounter with Yama and Shiva.
episodes.source: Mahabharata (Ganguli translation) Vana Parva; Shiva Purana

episodes.title: Gajendra Moksha: The Elephant Who Called for Help
episodes.covers: The elephant's struggle, his prayer to Vishnu, and liberation through divine grace.
episodes.source: Bhagavata Purana book 8

episodes.title: King Harishchandra: The King Who Would Not Tell a Lie
episodes.covers: A king tested through loss, suffering, and his commitment to truth.
episodes.source: Markandeya Purana (Pargiter translation)

episodes.title: Rishi Durvasa: The Sage Whose Anger Changed Destinies
episodes.covers: Stories of Durvasa's curses, their consequences, and the importance of context across different tellings.
episodes.source: Mahabharata (Ganguli translation) Adi and Vana Parvas; Vishnu Purana (Wilson translation) book 1

episodes.title: Narada: The Divine Sage Who Set Events in Motion
episodes.covers: Narada's journeys, music, devotion, and role as messenger and catalyst.
episodes.source: Mahabharata (Ganguli translation) Sabha Parva; Bhagavata Purana

episodes.title: The Story of Garuda: The Eagle Who Challenged the Gods
episodes.covers: Garuda's birth, his mother's bondage, the quest for amrita, and his relationship with Vishnu.
episodes.source: Mahabharata (Ganguli translation) Adi Parva, Astika Parva

series.title: Krishna: The Divine Life Story
series.note: This is a character-focused series. It revisits Krishna's place in the Mahabharata but explores his childhood, relationships, and devotional traditions in much greater depth.

episodes.title: Krishna's Birth: The Child Kamsa Feared
episodes.covers: Devaki, Vasudeva, the prophecy, and Krishna's escape from Kamsa.
episodes.source: Vishnu Purana (Wilson translation) book 5; Bhagavata Purana book 10

episodes.title: The Child of Gokul: Butter, Mischief, and Miracles
episodes.covers: Krishna's childhood pranks and the divine episodes associated with them.
episodes.source: Bhagavata Purana book 10; Vishnu Purana (Wilson translation) book 5

episodes.title: Putana, Trinavarta, and the Threats to Krishna
episodes.covers: The demons sent against the child and the stories of Krishna's early powers.
episodes.source: Bhagavata Purana book 10; Vishnu Purana (Wilson translation) book 5

episodes.title: Kaliya: The Serpent Who Poisoned the Yamuna
episodes.covers: Krishna's confrontation with Kaliya and the restoration of the river's waters.
episodes.source: Bhagavata Purana book 10; Vishnu Purana (Wilson translation) book 5

episodes.title: Govardhan: Why Krishna Challenged Indra
episodes.covers: The lifting of the mountain, the storm, and the debate over ritual and devotion.
episodes.source: Bhagavata Purana book 10; Vishnu Purana (Wilson translation) book 5

episodes.title: Radha and Krishna: The Love That Became Divine
episodes.covers: Radha's role, devotional interpretations of their relationship, and the many forms of the tradition.
episodes.source: Jayadeva's Gita Govinda (Arnold translation); Bhagavata Purana book 10

episodes.title: The Rasa Lila: What Happened on the Night of the Divine Dance?
episodes.covers: Krishna's dance with the gopis and the spiritual interpretations of this sacred narrative.
episodes.source: Bhagavata Purana book 10; Vishnu Purana (Wilson translation) book 5

episodes.title: Kamsa's Death: Krishna Returns to Mathura
episodes.covers: Krishna and Balarama's return, the wrestling arena, and Kamsa's downfall.
episodes.source: Bhagavata Purana book 10; Vishnu Purana (Wilson translation) book 5

episodes.title: Dwarka: The City Krishna Built by the Sea
episodes.covers: Krishna's later life, the relocation associated with Dwarka, and the political world of the Yadavas.
episodes.source: Vishnu Purana (Wilson translation) book 5; Mahabharata (Ganguli translation) Sabha Parva

episodes.title: The End of Krishna's Earthly Life
episodes.covers: The conflict within the Yadava clan, the circumstances of Krishna's departure, and the end of an age.
episodes.source: Mahabharata (Ganguli translation) Mausala Parva; Vishnu Purana (Wilson translation) book 5

series.title: The Wisdom Behind the Myths
series.note: This series turns listeners from followers of stories into people who understand the ideas beneath them. Use narrative examples rather than making these episodes sound like lectures.

episodes.title: What Is Dharma? When Doing the Right Thing Is Not Simple
episodes.covers: Dharma through Rama, Yudhishthira, Arjuna, and other difficult moral choices.
episodes.source: Mahabharata (Ganguli translation); Valmiki Ramayana (Griffith translation)

episodes.title: Karma: Can Your Actions Change Your Destiny?
episodes.covers: Karma, responsibility, consequences, and why it should not be reduced to a simple reward-and-punishment system.
episodes.source: Bhagavad Gita; Brihadaranyaka Upanishad (Muller translation)

episodes.title: Atman and Brahman: What Is the Self?
episodes.covers: The Upanishadic exploration of the self and ultimate reality, including differing interpretations.
episodes.source: Chandogya, Brihadaranyaka and Katha Upanishads (Muller translation)

episodes.title: Moksha: What Does It Mean to Escape the Cycle of Rebirth?
episodes.covers: Liberation, samsara, and the different paths described by Hindu traditions.
episodes.source: Katha Upanishad (Muller translation); Bhagavad Gita

episodes.title: The Bhagavad Gita's Three Paths
episodes.covers: Karma yoga, bhakti yoga, and jnana yoga, with examples of how they are understood.
episodes.source: Bhagavad Gita

episodes.title: Maya: Is the World an Illusion?
episodes.covers: The different meanings of maya and why it is more nuanced than saying the world does not exist.
episodes.source: Svetasvatara Upanishad; Bhagavata Purana; Vishnu Purana (Wilson translation)

episodes.title: Why Do Hindu Gods Have So Many Forms?
episodes.covers: Images, symbols, manifestations, and the diversity of understandings of the divine.
episodes.source: Bhagavad Gita chapter 11; Rig Veda (Griffith translation) 1.164

episodes.title: Bhakti: How Love Became a Path to God
episodes.covers: Devotion, surrender, poetry, music, and the growth of devotional traditions.
episodes.source: Bhagavad Gita chapter 12; Bhagavata Purana; Songs of Kabir (Tagore translation)

episodes.title: Fate vs Free Will: Are Our Lives Already Written?
episodes.covers: Destiny, divine will, human action, and moral responsibility in the epics and philosophical texts.
episodes.source: Mahabharata (Ganguli translation); Bhagavad Gita

episodes.title: What Happens After Death?
episodes.covers: Death, rebirth, heaven and hell in traditional cosmologies, and the possibility of liberation.
episodes.source: Katha Upanishad, Nachiketa and Yama (Muller translation); Garuda Purana (Wood and Subrahmanyam translation)

series.title: Living Hindu Traditions and the Many Ramayanas
series.note: This final series expands the listener's understanding beyond the most familiar Sanskrit narratives. It shows how mythology becomes part of lived religion, culture, art, and community.

episodes.title: The Many Ramayanas: Why Does Rama's Story Change?
episodes.covers: Valmiki's Ramayana, Tulsidas's Ramcharitmanas, Kamban's version, and other retellings.
episodes.source: Valmiki Ramayana (Griffith translation); Tulsidas's Ramcharitmanas (Growse translation); Kamban's Ramavataram

episodes.title: The Mahabharata Beyond the Battlefield
episodes.covers: Regional narratives, oral traditions, local performances, and stories that expand the epic.
episodes.source: Mahabharata (Ganguli translation); regional and oral traditions

episodes.title: Ganesh Chaturthi: The Festival of the Elephant-Headed God
episodes.covers: Ganesha's stories, the festival's devotional meanings, and its regional and historical development.
episodes.source: Shiva Purana; the history of the public festival from 1893

episodes.title: Diwali: One Festival, Several Mythological Stories
episodes.covers: Rama's return, Lakshmi traditions, and other regional stories associated with the festival.
episodes.source: Valmiki Ramayana (Griffith translation); Bhagavata Purana

episodes.title: Holi: Prahlada, Holika, and the Burning of Evil
episodes.covers: The narrative of Prahlada and Holika, and the different meanings of Holi across regions.
episodes.source: Vishnu Purana (Wilson translation) book 1; Bhagavata Purana book 7

episodes.title: Jagannath: The Mysterious Lord of Puri
episodes.covers: Jagannath's distinctive iconography, major traditions, and the story of the Rath Yatra.
episodes.source: Skanda Purana, the Indradyumna legend; W. W. Hunter's Orissa (1872)

episodes.title: Murugan and Ayyappa: The South Indian Divine Traditions
episodes.covers: The distinct stories and devotional worlds surrounding Murugan and Ayyappa.
episodes.source: Tirumurugarruppatai; Skanda Purana; Kerala Ayyappa tradition

episodes.title: Sacred Rivers and Mountains: The Geography of Mythology
episodes.covers: Ganga, Yamuna, Kailash, and other sacred landscapes and their narrative associations.
episodes.source: Valmiki Ramayana (Griffith translation); Mahabharata (Ganguli translation) Vana Parva, the pilgrimage chapters

episodes.title: The Ramayana Across Asia
episodes.covers: How Rama's story was adapted in Thailand, Indonesia, Cambodia, and elsewhere.
episodes.source: the Thai Ramakien, the Khmer Reamker and the Old Javanese Kakawin Ramayana

episodes.title: How Hindu Mythology Continues to Evolve
episodes.covers: Oral storytelling, dance, temple traditions, regional retellings, modern media, and the continuing life of these narratives.
episodes.source: Mahabharata (Ganguli translation); Valmiki Ramayana (Griffith translation); living performance traditions
